ارتضيا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَيَا (irtaḍayā) /ir.ta.dˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# اُرْتُضِيَا (urtuḍiyā) /ur.tu.dˤi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# اِرْتَضِيَا (irtaḍiyā) /ir.ta.dˤi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
